# NULL JSFX

> 75 professional audio effects for Cockos Reaper. Minimal design, maximum precision. Free and open source.

## Overview
NULL JSFX is a suite of 73 audio effect plugins written in EEL2 for Cockos Reaper's JSFX platform. Organized into three categories: ONE SLIDER (single-control effects), ESSENTIALS (daily-use tools), and ADVANCED (specialized processing). The One Slider plugins also ship as GFX JSFX (own interface, REAPER) and as VST3/CLAP plugins for any DAW on Windows, macOS and Linux; every version sounds identical to the original JSFX.
